name: Ink Pavilion
summary: A sweeping ink dome gathers into one tapered minaret and a curved foundation.
why: The mosque is a single joined silhouette. Its tapered tower grows directly out of the base, while the red collar lies inside that same tower. The doorway has a deliberate tall opening and clear roof above it.
risk: The asymmetric brush roof feels more expressive than architectural; its taper softens at 24px.
sub1: Dome, tower, and base flow together
reasonToChoose: You want a mosque that feels drawn by hand without texture or visual clutter.
